title: Detailed birthday cake with candles
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='plate' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#b8c4e0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#7f8fb8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cake' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f7c9a8'/>
      <stop offset='0.55' stop-color='#e8a87c'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c9814f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='frost' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fff6ea'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f6d9e6'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='flame' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fffbe0'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#ffd35c'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff8a3c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='40' ry='6' fill='url(#plate)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88.5' rx='40' ry='6' fill='#c3cde6' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- bottom cake tier -->
  <rect x='18' y='66' width='64' height='21' rx='4' fill='url(#cake)'/>
  <rect x='18' y='66' width='64' height='4' rx='2' fill='#f2b98e'/>
  <!-- drips of frosting on bottom tier -->
  <path d='M18 70 L18 78 Q21 84 24 78 L24 70 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <path d='M27 70 L27 81 Q30 88 33 81 L33 70 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <path d='M39 70 L39 79 Q42 86 45 79 L45 70 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <path d='M52 70 L52 82 Q55 89 58 82 L58 70 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <path d='M64 70 L64 79 Q67 86 70 79 L70 70 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <path d='M75 70 L75 80 Q78 87 82 80 L82 70 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <rect x='18' y='64' width='64' height='6' rx='3' fill='url(#frost)'/>

  <!-- sprinkle dots on bottom tier -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='61' r='1.4' fill='#ff6fa8'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='60' r='1.4' fill='#6fc8ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='61' r='1.4' fill='#ffd35c'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='60' r='1.4' fill='#8affa0'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='61' r='1.4' fill='#ff6fa8'/>

  <!-- middle tier -->
  <rect x='25' y='48' width='50' height='18' rx='4' fill='#f2a9c4'/>
  <rect x='25' y='48' width='50' height='4' rx='2' fill='#fbc4d8'/>
  <!-- drips on middle tier -->
  <path d='M25 52 L25 60 Q28 66 31 60 L31 52 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <path d='M35 52 L35 63 Q38 70 41 63 L41 52 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <path d='M47 52 L47 61 Q50 68 53 61 L53 52 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <path d='M59 52 L59 64 Q62 71 65 64 L65 52 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <path d='M70 52 L70 61 Q73 68 76 61 L76 52 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <rect x='25' y='46' width='50' height='6' rx='3' fill='url(#frost)'/>

  <!-- cherry dots on middle tier -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='44' r='2' fill='#ff4f6f'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='43.5' r='2' fill='#ff4f6f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='2' fill='#ff4f6f'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='43.5' r='2' fill='#ff4f6f'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='44' r='2' fill='#ff4f6f'/>

  <!-- top tier -->
  <rect x='33' y='33' width='34' height='14' rx='4' fill='#9ad9f5'/>
  <rect x='33' y='33' width='34' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c4ecfb'/>
  <path d='M33 37 L33 44 Q36 50 39 44 L39 37 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <path d='M42 37 L42 47 Q45 53 48 47 L48 37 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <path d='M52 37 L52 45 Q55 51 58 45 L58 37 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <path d='M61 37 L61 47 Q64 53 67 47 L67 37 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <rect x='33' y='31' width='34' height='6' rx='3' fill='url(#frost)'/>

  <!-- candles -->
  <!-- candle 1 -->
  <rect x='38' y='19' width='4' height='13' rx='1.5' fill='#ff8f4a'/>
  <rect x='38' y='19' width='2' height='13' rx='1' fill='#ffb98a'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='12.5' rx='2.6' ry='4.2' fill='url(#flame)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='13.5' rx='1.2' ry='2.2' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='16.5' x2='40' y2='19' stroke='#6b4a33' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- candle 2 -->
  <rect x='48' y='17' width='4' height='15' rx='1.5' fill='#7fd4a8'/>
  <rect x='48' y='17' width='2' height='15' rx='1' fill='#b6ebcf'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='10.5' rx='2.6' ry='4.2' fill='url(#flame)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='11.5' rx='1.2' ry='2.2' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='14.5' x2='50' y2='17' stroke='#6b4a33' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- candle 3 -->
  <rect x='58' y='19' width='4' height='13' rx='1.5' fill='#b48ef2'/>
  <rect x='58' y='19' width='2' height='13' rx='1' fill='#d9c4fb'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='12.5' rx='2.6' ry='4.2' fill='url(#flame)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='13.5' rx='1.2' ry='2.2' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='16.5' x2='60' y2='19' stroke='#6b4a33' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- candle glow dots -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='11' r='0.8' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='0.8' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='11' r='0.8' fill='#fff3b0'/>
</svg>
